free-plan.rationale: Free MIT app; optional paid phone-voice allowance.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete cost statement says Happy is free and optional phone voice is the only paid item, sold by subscription; it lists no no-paid-plan option. External model subscriptions and own-host costs are excluded.

subscription.rationale: The optional phone voice allowance is sold through an in-app subscription. The core ADE is free.

sso.rationale: First-party recipe documents organization IdP sign-in for team mode; the released agent and desktop contain the JWT and sign-in-discovery code. Scope: self-hosted team mode with an organization-run OAuth authorization server. Not tested.

issue-tracking.rationale: The product owns persistent task records with state, independent IDs and idle drafts, rather than only a session list. Each task links one root conversation.

pr-workflow.rationale: The pinned Git module, API and clients have no product-owned PR operations; generic external shell/MCP use is separately scoped.
